content.title: Free Sales and Use Tax Classes
content.summary: The Revenue staff is offering free monthly classes on Sales and Use Tax, covering topics such as licensing, tax forms, record-keeping, and audits. Classes are held on the second Thursday of each month from 12 p.m. to 1 p.m. in the Finance Conference room at 8001 Ralston Road, with opportunities for one-on-one assistance for specific tax-related questions.
content.body:
The Revenue staff invites you to attend a free class on collecting and reporting Sales and Use Tax.

## Tax topics include

- Licensing requirements, tax forms, and payment options
- What and when to tax or not tax items
- Record-keeping tips
- What is use tax and how it applies to your business
- What happens when your account is delinquent
- Refund requirements
- What to expect from an audit

Bring along your specific tax-related questions, as there will be time during and afterwards for  one-on-one assistance for those who may need it.

**Second Thursdays monthly, 12 p.m. to 1 p.m. in the Finance Conference room, located on the 1st floor of the Annex (east of City Hall), 8001 Ralston Road. 720-898-7100.**
